name: solid
description: A declarative, efficient, and flexible JavaScript library for building user interfaces.
one_liner: A tool programmers use to build fast, responsive website interfaces.
buyer: No direct buyer — free developer infrastructure, not a product a business pays for on its own.
business_use_cases: An agency builds a performance-sensitive client app with it to hit tight load-time requirements.
A startup picks it as a lighter alternative to React for a resource-constrained product.
No standalone commercial product opportunity beyond using it as a building block.

money_ideas.idea: Offer SolidJS development consulting to teams adopting it.

steal_this: Nothing to productize directly — the opportunity is dev services, not a product built on top of the library itself.
